rendering_rules: Translate explanatory words only. do_not_translate=true means all five renderings equal the exact English token.
Mark each firmware_span as firmware/shim text in English using the translated explanatory label; never claim it is a translated PaOS screen.
A translated fingerprint label never translates the actual digest. Subject and digest bytes come from the selected certificate, never from glossary examples.
Keep the two MokManager SHA-1 lines separate, each ten upper-case byte pairs, with nothing else on either line; do not substitute SHA-256.
Paths, filenames, volume labels, option names, locale tags, reason codes, sizes, UUIDs and confirmation/one-time codes remain exact typed values.
Do not alter bash placeholders, command syntax, critical-step order or refusal/partial-effect meaning. Whole-message catalogs follow separately accepted English.
Do not expose actual passwords, private signing keys or BitLocker recovery-key values in examples or public reports.
This installer/guide glossary is not a native glyph-closure or layout claim. Native core glossary and catalog/header pins stay unchanged.
Use the certificate-qualified fingerprint term at first use on each page. Blank disk always carries the tool-classification qualifier; it is not a user judgment that the disk has no files.
